svg.aria-label: Topology: Human surfaces attach to zmx sessions; root, control and worker sessions run under zmx; the durable core lives outside every repo.

g.text: ZMX: ONE DAEMON PER SESSION, OWNS THE PTY
serves TUI and web view from the store; restartable at
workers: headless, stream-json, one task each, exit when done
one binary under zmx: journal, state,
core-owned bare repo; children write only to worktrees; the core verifies, fast-forwards default, then syncs to any remote
awaitable: a resolved promise, a fired timer or a completed step
signal from a session or an arbiter
attach or read; owns no process
